name: E25 Payment Procedures
rows: Clauses PAY-1, PAY-7 and PAY-8: the Thursday run, holds and the minimum balance
Frozen evidence from this run. Clause text is copied word for word.

Vendor payments are released once a week, on Thursday, from the operating account. Each run pays the approved bills that fall due before the next run, so no bill is paid late and none is paid early without a reason.
A bill on hold or in dispute is not paid until the hold is released in writing. A bill addressed to another HANGS entity is paid by that entity only.

Keep at least $250,000.00 in the operating account after committed payroll. Expected receipts are not cash. The Controller and the CFO approve each run over $100,000.00 before release; the batch is prepared for them and never released by its preparer.
